page.overview:
What is Mirror Team Rocket's Meowth?

Mirror Team Rocket's Meowth is a -type Pokémon owned by Mirror Jessie and Mirror James.

When Team Rocket was heading back to their world, they encountered their mirror counterparts, who were described as "the heroes of justice", including Mirror Meowth.
